title: Very Light Indulgent Turkish Pecan Nuts Sis Kebap
description: A sweet and light Turkish dish featuring pecan nuts, nimono-simmer, and anti-inflammatory-friendly ingredients, served in a ti-leaf wrap.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of coconut oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped red onion and sauté for 3-4 minutes until translucent.
Add the turmeric, ginger, salt, and black pepper, and stir for 1 minute.
Add the chopped pecan nuts and stir to combine.
Pour in the green chutney and stir to combine.
Add the honey and stir to combine.
Simmer the mixture for 2-3 minutes until the flavors are well combined.
Warm the ti-leaf wraps by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the sis kebap by spooning the pecan nut mixture onto the center of each wrap, followed by a sprinkle of cilantro.
Repeat with the remaining ingredients to make more sis kebap.
